scope: read-only hardware evidence report (wsm-hwcheck 0.2.0, report schema 1.0.0)
four installer entrypoints (CLI --install, Guided, TUI and Calamares) over one preview-only executor

authenticated Guix evaluation and system build of the Compatibility profiles for this candidate; structural lock policy is not a substitute for Guix authentication
physical support claims for the Compatibility NVIDIA/Pascal profile, including GTX 1050 Ti; package declarations and QEMU enumeration are not physical bind/render evidence
